a310e37c93dc245aadd6.en: Conditional sentences use if to show that one thing depends on another.
a310e37c93dc245aadd6.id: Kalimat pengandaian (conditional sentence) memakai if untuk menunjukkan bahwa satu hal bergantung pada hal lain.

1bfeb2cf240e01fe533c.en: For facts that are always true, use the present tense in both parts.
1bfeb2cf240e01fe533c.id: Untuk fakta yang selalu benar, pakai present tense di kedua bagian.

25d5aaeeeb4b363b41f9.en: For real future possibilities, use the present after if and will in the result.
25d5aaeeeb4b363b41f9.id: Untuk hal yang benar-benar mungkin terjadi nanti, pakai present setelah if dan will di bagian hasilnya.

8a2def6b05113bb1804a.en: For imaginary situations, use the past after if and would in the result.
8a2def6b05113bb1804a.id: Untuk keadaan yang hanya dibayangkan, pakai past setelah if dan would di bagian hasilnya.

ec01f6762c4bfba23aa1.en: For past situations that did not happen, use had and would have.
ec01f6762c4bfba23aa1.id: Untuk keadaan masa lalu yang tidak terjadi, pakai had dan would have.

a4f5c47c712c78c4f219.en: People cannot be fish, so this is imaginary. It uses were and would.
a4f5c47c712c78c4f219.id: Manusia tidak bisa menjadi ikan, jadi ini hanya khayalan. Kalimat ini memakai were dan would.

f82cec9acd45fa8c98b8.en: If we had known, we would have come. Had in the if clause goes with would have in the result.
f82cec9acd45fa8c98b8.id: If we had known, we would have come. Had pada if clause berpasangan dengan would have pada bagian akibatnya.

f30e79341505814520ce.en: If you heat ice, it melts. This is always true, so both clauses are in the present tense.
f30e79341505814520ce.id: If you heat ice, it melts. Ini selalu benar, jadi kedua klausa memakai present tense.

1d4bb76a9366f7298440.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home. For a real possibility in the future, use if with the present tense and will in the result.
1d4bb76a9366f7298440.id: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home. Untuk hal yang benar-benar mungkin terjadi di masa depan, pakai if dengan present tense dan will pada bagian akibatnya.

bda3be5f748c3756fc6f.en: People do not have wings, so this is imaginary. It uses had after if and would in the result.
bda3be5f748c3756fc6f.id: Manusia tidak punya sayap, jadi ini hanya khayalan. Kalimat ini memakai had setelah if dan would pada bagian akibatnya.

0574f570adca808cecc1.en: If you water the plant, it will grow. The if clause comes first, then a comma, then the result.
0574f570adca808cecc1.id: If you water the plant, it will grow. If clause ditulis lebih dulu, lalu koma, lalu akibatnya.

536f71ee85476594e5f2.en: Facts use the present tense, real future possibilities use will, imaginary situations use would, and past situations that did not happen use would have.
536f71ee85476594e5f2.id: Fakta memakai present tense, hal yang benar-benar mungkin terjadi di masa depan memakai will, keadaan khayalan memakai would, dan keadaan masa lalu yang tidak terjadi memakai would have.

6ed9177fb8106b65e6ed.en: In imaginary situations, we say If I were you. This is how we give advice politely.
6ed9177fb8106b65e6ed.id: Pada keadaan khayalan, kita mengatakan If I were you. Begitulah cara memberi saran dengan sopan.

22dd1a10e3f3e5e1bd85.en: He did not check the weather, so he did not take his umbrella. Past situations that did not happen use had in the if clause and would have in the result.
22dd1a10e3f3e5e1bd85.id: Dia tidak memeriksa cuaca, jadi dia tidak membawa payungnya. Keadaan masa lalu yang tidak terjadi memakai had pada if clause dan would have pada bagian akibatnya.

a17aacf66da1e3fcdbda.en: The correct sentences use the present after if for real possibilities, and had studied with would have passed for the past.
a17aacf66da1e3fcdbda.id: Kalimat yang benar memakai present setelah if untuk hal yang benar-benar mungkin terjadi, dan had studied dengan would have passed untuk masa lalu.

ecb71f8d85744511f2b2.en: The sentence imagines a different past. They did not plant the seeds in March, so they do not have tomatoes yet.
ecb71f8d85744511f2b2.id: Kalimat itu membayangkan masa lalu yang berbeda. Mereka tidak menanam biji itu pada bulan Maret, jadi mereka belum punya tomat.

de530f0e69a194cc2fae.en: Unless means if not, so the sentence means: If you don’t revise, you won’t pass the test.
de530f0e69a194cc2fae.id: Unless berarti if not, jadi arti kalimat itu: If you don’t revise, you won’t pass the test.

bcb05b90ac86358a05cf.en: The zero conditional is used for facts. Both clauses use the present simple: If you cool water, it freezes.
bcb05b90ac86358a05cf.id: Zero conditional dipakai untuk fakta. Kedua klausa memakai present simple: If you cool water, it freezes.

6662b605aa8168a05aad.en: The first is a zero conditional, so go. The second is a second conditional, so I would share.
6662b605aa8168a05aad.id: Yang pertama adalah zero conditional, jadi go. Yang kedua adalah second conditional, jadi I would share.

c39ef441b974bf01ea0e.en: The second conditional uses a past verb in the if clause and would in the other half.
c39ef441b974bf01ea0e.id: Second conditional memakai kata kerja bentuk lampau pada if clause dan would pada bagian lainnya.

4e56019070a19394f8dc.en: In a first conditional the if clause uses the present simple: If Amara finishes early.
4e56019070a19394f8dc.id: Pada first conditional, if clause memakai present simple: If Amara finishes early.

b2ba219efbcaa28e0532.en: If it is sunny tomorrow, we will go to the beach. The if clause comes before the comma and the result comes after.
b2ba219efbcaa28e0532.id: If it is sunny tomorrow, we will go to the beach. If clause ditulis sebelum koma dan akibatnya ditulis sesudahnya.

286eb6ca69601309e413.en: The first conditional talks about real possibilities. The if clause is present and the result uses will.
286eb6ca69601309e413.id: First conditional membicarakan hal yang benar-benar mungkin terjadi. If clause memakai present dan bagian akibatnya memakai will.

e9ced90a5e8e348706e7.en: Zero conditionals are facts. First conditionals use will for likely results. Second conditionals use would for imaginary situations.
e9ced90a5e8e348706e7.id: Zero conditional berisi fakta. First conditional memakai will untuk akibat yang mungkin terjadi. Second conditional memakai would untuk keadaan khayalan.

f7f535c818e8a9003813.en: First conditional: If plus present simple, then will plus the base verb.
f7f535c818e8a9003813.id: First conditional: If ditambah present simple, lalu will ditambah kata kerja dasar (base verb).

3e0093937b52149850da.en: Unless means if not, so the two sentences mean the same.
3e0093937b52149850da.id: Unless berarti if not, jadi kedua kalimat itu artinya sama.

3fc50310eaf9469beb08.en: The third conditional is for past situations that did not happen: If it had not rained, the picnic would have gone ahead.
3fc50310eaf9469beb08.id: Third conditional dipakai untuk keadaan masa lalu yang tidak terjadi: If it had not rained, the picnic would have gone ahead.

ad6f7c9609ae4f0c9144.en: This is a mixed conditional: If plus past perfect, then would plus the base verb.
ad6f7c9609ae4f0c9144.id: Ini adalah mixed conditional: If ditambah past perfect, lalu would ditambah kata kerja dasar (base verb).

aa8ef173214dca4b1932.en: The correct sentences match their verb forms. The wrong ones put would or will in the if clause or use the wrong form after would.
aa8ef173214dca4b1932.id: Kalimat yang benar memakai bentuk kata kerja yang cocok. Kalimat yang salah menaruh would atau will pada if clause, atau memakai bentuk yang salah setelah would.

08528d13504cddc52fef.en: Third conditional: If I had known, I would have visited.
08528d13504cddc52fef.id: Ini third conditional: If I had known, I would have visited.

ce7b9de405464df2bf91.en: The third conditional shows the opposite of the facts. In fact Hadi missed the bus and was late.
ce7b9de405464df2bf91.id: Third conditional menunjukkan kebalikan dari fakta. Kenyataannya, Hadi ketinggalan bus dan terlambat.

4b37b4ee07fc2ba61627.en: It could really happen, so it uses present tense after if and will in the main clause.
4b37b4ee07fc2ba61627.id: Hal itu bisa benar-benar terjadi, jadi kalimat itu memakai present tense setelah if dan will pada induk kalimat (main clause).

c73ad7177d434b46afad.en: The speaker is not a bird, so this is imagined.
c73ad7177d434b46afad.id: Pembicara bukan burung, jadi ini hanya khayalan.

0299817297662df41211.en: The speaker does not have wings. It uses had and would for something imaginary.
0299817297662df41211.id: Pembicara tidak punya sayap. Kalimat itu memakai had dan would untuk hal yang hanya khayalan.

28f8143f86515db42ce9.en: For a real possibility, we use the present tense after if, so the correct sentence is If I see him, I will tell him.
28f8143f86515db42ce9.id: Untuk hal yang benar-benar mungkin terjadi, kita memakai present tense setelah if, jadi kalimat yang benar adalah If I see him, I will tell him.

7bcb2847d1f0a4967e7a.en: In imaginary situations, formal English uses were after if, even with I.
7bcb2847d1f0a4967e7a.id: Pada keadaan khayalan, bahasa Inggris formal memakai were setelah if, bahkan dengan I.

b0f2cc6454e1d41c202a.en: It refers to the past. She did not study and did not pass.
b0f2cc6454e1d41c202a.id: Kalimat itu membicarakan masa lalu. Dia tidak belajar dan tidak lulus.

7a8bcbbedfe34fde8c14.en: For imagined situations, formal English uses were: If I were a bird.
7a8bcbbedfe34fde8c14.id: Untuk keadaan khayalan, bahasa Inggris formal memakai were: If I were a bird.
